name: savas-oyunu
description: Lobili, en fazla 20 kişilik 2D tepeden bakış çok oyunculu savaş oyunu. Çevrimdışı bot modu, PWA ve Android APK desteği.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.js && node test/ws-protocol.mjs && node test/binary.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node test/browser.mjs && node test/browser-selfupdate.mjs && node test/browser-assist.mjs && node test/browser-bomb.mjs && node test/browser-grass.mjs && node test/binary-net.mjs && node test/browser-modes.mjs && node test/browser-offline.mjs && node test/browser-bush.mjs && node test/browser-sniper.mjs && node test/browser-aimfire.mjs && node test/browser-lobby.mjs && node test/browser-origin.mjs && node test/browser-update.mjs && node test/browser-apkupdate.mjs && node test/browser-settings.mjs && node test/browser-visuals.mjs && node test/browser-nodaynight.mjs && node test/browser-inputmode.mjs && node test/browser-slowserver.mjs && node test/browser-coldstart.mjs && node test/browser-bundle.mjs && node test/browser-apk-real.mjs && node scripts/build-single.mjs && node test/browser-single.mjs
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/build-www.mjs && node scripts/make-bundle.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.test:selfupdate: node scripts/build-www.mjs && node scripts/make-bundle.mjs && node test/browser-selfupdate.mjs
